1479-2841-2922-8293.easyPrerequisites:
You're able to play a land this turn.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Obscura Storefront.
1479-2841-2922-8293.description:
Fetch a land using Obscura Storefront.
When the fetched land enters, Cleveland Booker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

4881-5487-6909.manaNeeded: {1}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-5487-6909.description:
Cast Molten Duplication by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

1339-1832-5231-6559.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-5231-6559.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1018-5531-5694-6763-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
1018-5531-5694-6763-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Skullwinder and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Skullwinder and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.
1018-5531-5694-6763-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Skullwinder and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

2034-2558-3490-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

586-864-2267-3125-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2267-3125-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Tormod.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either Kelpie Guide or North Pole Patrol

2085-7014-7786.description:
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting North Pole Patrol.
If Kelpie Guide has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
If North Pole Patrol has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

206-1843-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-1843-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1263-4871-4976-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2232-3652-4541-5705.manaNeeded: {2} at most if you control fewer than eight Treasures
2232-3652-4541-5705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six Treasures.
2232-3652-4541-5705.description:
Activate at least six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {6}.
Cast Marut by paying at least {6} gained from Treasures, plus an extra up to {2} if needed.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cloudstone Curio and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Ornithopter from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Marut. When Marut enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure for each mana from a Treasure spent to cast it.
Cast Ornithopter by paying its mana cost.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cloudstone Curio and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
If needed, activate up to two Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C} for each one sacrificed.
Repeat.
2232-3652-4541-5705.notes: If you control seven or more Treasures, use at least seven Treasures to cast Marut. If you use eight Treasures, forego step 13.

3923-4050-6573-7639.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone two times this game.
3923-4050-6573-7639.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation by paying {U} due to Font of Magic.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Mystic Speculation.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a slumber counter on it

460-539-3201.description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {G}{U}
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Arixmethes.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

3259-4478-5484.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield and doesn't have summoning sickness.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander that doesn't have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-4478-5484.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2511-3817-4200.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-2146-4331-4993.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3007-3899-4552-6774.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
539-3007-3899-4552-6774.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Toymaker
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

862-4050-4053-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that has power or toughness 1 or less and that can be cast using one colored mana.
862-4050-4053-6989.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the additional creature, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from your graveyard by paying its mana cost. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

147-3967-6814.description:
Cast Abnormal Endurance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Abnormal Endurance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Abnormal Endurance.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities from step 5.

2866-2921-3200-4986.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2173-3661-4779-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2043-3910-4659-5346.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Breya that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Put the token Breya into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Breya's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Thopters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Crime Novelist triggers twice, adding {R}{R} and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1374-3626-5499-6791--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1374-3626-5499-6791--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

261-338-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-338-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

413-4871-6010--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the persist creature trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure token enters the battlefield, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1289-5078-5864-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
1289-5078-5864-6650.notablePrerequisites: Birds of Paradise does not have summoning sickness.
1289-5078-5864-6650.description:
Activate Birds of Paradise by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Repeat.

1580-2921-4647-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1020-1976-2866-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1838-5657-6489.manaNeeded: {4}{C}{C}{C}{G/U}{G/U} plus enough mana to cast the additional Eldrazi spell
1838-5657-6489.notablePrerequisites: You have another Eldrazi creature card in hand.
1838-5657-6489.description:
Cast any other Eldrazi except Drowner of Truth by paying its mana cost, triggering Ulalek.
Holding priority, cast Drowner of Truth by paying {4}{C}{G/U}{G/U}.
Drowner of Truth and Ulalek trigger.
Resolve the Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Drowner of Truth's trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

225-1479-3703-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-3703-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Sporemound trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Sporemound and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

803-3951-5256-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
803-3951-5256-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

2178-5686-5698.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Ulamog's Dreadsire does not have summoning sickness.
2178-5686-5698.description:
Activate Ulamog's Dreadsire by tapping it, creating a 10/10 Eldrazi creature tokens.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Eldrazi token.
When the Eldrazi token dies, Ulamog's Dreadsire triggers, untapping Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

511-817-3062-4050-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
511-817-3062-4050-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2281-2292-6125.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Fiendish Panda.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Fiendish Panda.
When Fiendish Panda dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Fiendish Panda from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fiendish Panda trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2292-2584-4133.description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
If an ability from Viscera Seer is waiting to resolve, let it resolve.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Soul Collector.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-3654-4186.notablePrerequisites:
Plaguemaw Beast does not have summoning sickness.
Scurry Oak has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Plaguemaw Beast.
2178-3654-4186.description:
Activate Plaguemaw Beast by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Plaguemaw Beast triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Plaguemaw Beast ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

1462-2812-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1462-2812-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, Knight of Doves triggers, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
Repeat.

224-433-1525-1644.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
224-433-1525-1644.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tatyova and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Resolve the Tatyova trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

3425-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield.
3425-3490-4659.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield.
Celebrity Fencer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Krark-Clan Ironworks triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Celebrity Fencer.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Celebrity Fencer trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
